title: 1918 US expeditionary force into Russia

tellings.quote: the a full-scale US financed US military foreign expeditionary force into Russia to try in 1918.

plain: A lawyer and researcher, Dan Sheehan, says that in 1918 the United States paid for and sent a full-scale military force into Russia, citing Robert Lansing, the US Secretary of State at the time. He raises it in a conversation about President Kennedy and UFOs, as part of a longer story about hidden decisions made by those in power.
